item.title: Version 2.8.0
item.description:
What's New in 2.8.0

  • Fixed port forwarding being ignored on many routers — If you forwarded a UDP port to this computer and set it as the direct connection port, some routers still left your devices connecting through a relay: the open port was never actually offered to the connecting device. Remio now announces the forwarded port itself, so a correctly forwarded port reliably gives you a direct connection — even from cellular networks.
